We're seeing a sharp spike in 429s and downstream timeouts hitting our production integrations starting ~08:50 PDT. Error rate on inbound inference requests climbed to ~22% for the last 20 minutes, and our clients are reporting heavy retry activity which is amplifying the load. Attached is a screenshot of the errors page and a sample request id (req_0a7b). Can we get an immediate bridge and an ETA for mitigation? Impact: tier-1 clients experiencing timeouts and a couple of automated jobs failing which blocks billing reconciliations.

Thanks — please loop in SRE and account team.

Quick update from SRE triage:
- Datadog link: https://app.datadoghq.com/graph/embed/xyz-medverify-429-spike
- Observed behavior: 429s begin at 08:48 and correlate with token-bucket drain on project "medverify:prod-west". The org-level routing allowed traffic into multiple projects but the project-level limit was left at 10 TPS after the tiering change on 2026-07-31 (we rolled a new tier map).
- Result: token bucket exhaustion -> clients retrying -> effective load spikes -> neighboring projects see elevated latency/5xx as well (cascading).

Immediate mitigation executed at 09:40: temporarily increased medverify:prod-west project quota to 80 TPS and enabled a 60s smoothing window at the edge. Early signal: 429 rate dropped from 22% to 2% within 7 minutes; latency back to baseline.

Root cause hypothesis: tiering rollout changed mapping from org->project limits but DID NOT backfill project-level overrides for some legacy projects. The rollout test coverage didn't include high-concurrency jobs.

Next actions:
- Short term (today): keep smoothing on for 24h, monitor. Roll back if adverse impact observed.
- Mid term (this week): automated check to validate project quota >= org-tier baseline before pushing mapping changes; add canary with high-concurrency simulation.
- Postmortem: assign JIRA-OPS-1298 for postmortem and remediation.

I'll attach the config snippet and the mitigation runbook.

—Aditya
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
